records.rationale:

```rb

```

records.issue_text: No UNIQUE constraint on embeddable_hosts.host; duplicates and case variants both validate and collide on lower(host) lookup, so duplicate row's category is silently ignored

Lookup uses `where("lower(host) = ?", host).first` in `EmbeddableHost.record_for_host`, so if duplicate rows exist (including case variants), the `.first` row will be chosen and the other row’s `category_id` will be ignored, causing incorrect category selection in `TopicEmbed.import` (`category: eh.try(:category_id)`).
